Eat not, Want not

You need to eat. But you need to keep an eye on him... what is he putting in the food?

Watch the chef to see what goes into the food. Avoid eating your allergy! To clear dishes, hold on the speech bubble to the left of the dish and then swipe right. Go for the high score and see how many dishes you can eat. Fullscreen recommended.

This game was made in 7 days for the Brackeys Game Jam with the theme 'Trust No One'.
